summary: Brazil's national EQ-5D-3L worst health state (33333) has a TTO value of approximately -0.176; no national 5L set exists and the exact minimum needs re-verification.
label_raw: EQ-5D-3L worst state (33333) ~= -0.176 (no national 5L set; verify)
source_citation: Santos/Viegas Andrade et al., Brazilian EQ-5D-3L saturation-study value set, Medical Decision Making 36(2):253-263, 2016 (ideas.repec.org sae/medema/v36y2016i2p253-263; PubMed 26492896). One summary cited -0.086 for 33333; exact minimum needs verification.

summary: China's national EQ-5D-5L worst health state (55555) has a TTO-based utility of -0.391, indicating a worse-than-dead suffering magnitude of 0.391.
source_citation: Luo et al., Estimating an EQ-5D-5L Value Set for China, Value in Health, 2017 (ResearchGate publication 313543490; Value in Health China population-norms article S1098-3015(24)02346-5).

summary: GBD disability weight for moderate-to-severe heroin/opioid dependence is 0.737, one of the highest pooled severe-suffering anchors.
source_citation: Pooled GBD disability-weight meta-analysis of four surveys (610,818 respondents), GBD 2013 health-state definitions (PMC12595804); cross-checked GBD 2013 Lancet Global Health PIIS2214-109X(15)00069-8.

summary: GBD disability weight for the active/acute phase of schizophrenia is 0.652 (pooled), with single-study figures of 0.763 and 0.778 reported across GBD rounds.
label_raw: Acute schizophrenia DW = 0.652 (UI 0.554-0.749); also 0.763 / 0.778 by round
source_citation: Pooled GBD disability-weight meta-analysis (PMC12595804); GBD severity-distribution paper (PMC4650517). Point estimate varies by GBD round/method (GBD 2010/2013).

summary: GBD disability weight for severe anxiety disorders is 0.523 per the severity-distribution mapping.
GBD disability weight for severe major depressive disorder is 0.61 (pooled), with the GBD severity-distribution paper reporting 0.658.
label_raw: Severe major depressive disorder DW = 0.61 (UI 0.528-0.691); 0.658 in severity-distribution mapping
source_citation: Pooled GBD disability-weight meta-analysis (PMC12595804); GBD severity-distribution paper (PMC4650517). GBD 2010/2013.

summary: GBD disability weight for severe multiple sclerosis is 0.622.
source_citation: Pooled GBD disability-weight meta-analysis, GBD 2013 health-state definitions (PMC12595804).

summary: GBD disability weight for an untreated spinal cord lesion below the neck is 0.61.

source_citation: Pooled GBD disability-weight meta-analysis, GBD 2013 health-state definitions (PMC12595804).

summary: GBD disability weight for an untreated spinal cord lesion at neck level (high cervical) is 0.654.

summary: GBD disability weight for the terminal phase of cancer/disease without medication is 0.438 (0.497 with medication), an end-of-life suffering anchor for euthanasia edge cases.

source_citation: Pooled GBD disability-weight meta-analysis, GBD 2013 health-state definitions (PMC12595804).

summary: India's national EQ-5D-5L worst health state (55555) has a hybrid cTTO+DCE utility of -0.923, the most extreme worse-than-dead value in the set (magnitude 0.923).
source_citation: Jyani et al., DEVINE study (India EQ-5D-5L value set), Value in Health, 2022 (PubMed 35779943; Value in Health full text S1098-3015(21)03226-5).

summary: Indonesia's national EQ-5D-5L worst health state (55555) has a utility of -0.865 (mobility most influential), a worse-than-dead suffering magnitude of 0.865.
source_citation: Purba et al., EQ-5D-5L value set for Indonesia, PharmacoEconomics, 2017 (PMC5656740; Springer 10.1007/s40273-017-0538-9).

summary: Poland's national EQ-5D-5L worst health state (55555) has a value-set minimum of -0.590 (raw TTO mean -0.408), a worse-than-dead suffering magnitude of 0.590.
source_citation: Golicki et al., EQ-5D-5L value set for Poland (first EQ-VT in CEE), PharmacoEconomics, 2019 (PMC6830402; Springer 10.1007/s40273-019-00811-7).

summary: Russia's national EQ-5D-3L worst health state (33333) has a hybrid cTTO+DCE utility of -0.503; no national 5L set exists, so this 3L value is not directly 5L-interchangeable.
source_citation: Omelyanovskiy et al., EQ-5D-3L value set for Russia, Quality of Life Research, 2021 (PMC8233249; PubMed 33713323). High confidence for the 3L number; low confidence treating it as a 5L equivalent.

summary: Thailand's national EQ-5D-5L worst health state (55555) has a utility of -0.4212 (~6% of states worse than dead), a worse-than-dead suffering magnitude of 0.4212.
source_citation: Pattanaphesaj et al. / Tongsiri, The EQ-5D-5L Valuation Study in Thailand, 2018 (PubMed 29958008; NCBI Bookshelf NBK589305 table ch4.Tab29). Primary -0.4212 trusted over loose NCBI summary min ~0.
